node: Grid EPC subcontractors, utility field services, testing, commissioning, maintenance, vegetation management, and specialized labor
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the grid field-services bottleneck found one reference leader and three smaller public-market candidates. The underfollowed lane is strongest where the company has direct transmission/distribution construction, substation, utility maintenance, testing, inspection, commissioning, or utility-services exposure. Quanta Services is retained only as the context anchor. MYR Group and Primoris are direct grid-construction and utility-services candidates; NV5 is a less obvious testing/inspection/commissioning and utility-services candidate that may sit closer to the certification and asset-lifecycle chokepoint than traditional EPC narratives. No buy/sell view is implied.
